l-e-m3-b01-09.material: ① I like ___ you wrote. ② I like the story ___ you wrote. what ayeke na ①, na that ayeke na ②. Wara standard so a lingbi ti yeke na bezoin ni mingi ti pëpe use ni.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.o.a: Si nom ayeke na kozo ti fa ni wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.o.b: Si you ayeke subject wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: Na yâ ti phrases use ni kue, you ayeke subject.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.o.c: Si wrote ayeke na ngoi so ahon wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Na yâ ti phrases use ni kue, wrote ayeke na ngoi so ahon.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.d: Kötä ti phrase apëpe what na that pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Tongana nom ayeke na kozo ti fa ni (story), sara kua na that. Tongana mo tene "ye so ~" na nom tongana so pëpe, sara kua na what.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: ② ayeke na story na kozo, ni la asara kua na that, na ① ayeke na nom ti fa ni pëpe, ni la asara kua na what. Ni la si nom ayeke na kozo wala pëpe ayeke standard.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: you na wrote ayeke mbeni na phrases use ni kue, ni la si nom ayeke na kozo ti fa ni wala pëpe ayeke ye so a lingbi ti yeke na bezoin ni mingi.

l-e-m3-b01-10.title: Standard so apëpe ye so a sïngö na hakinda
l-e-m3-b01-10.goal: Ti wara standard so apëpe ye so a sïngö na yâ ti texte na hakinda, sioni standard (information) so a lingbi ti yeke na bezoin ni mingi, na fa ndani ti so mo sioni ni.
l-e-m3-b01-10.material: Texte: The streets were wet this morning. ① The streets were wet. ② It rained last night. ① ayeke ye so a sïngö na yâ ti texte, na ② ayeke hakinda. Wara standard so a lingbi ti yeke na bezoin ni mingi ti pëpe use ni.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Kötä ti phrase apëpe ye so a sïngö na hakinda pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Si a sïngö ni gbä na yâ ti texte wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Si ni ayeke na ngoi so ahon wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Phrases use ni kue ayeke tënë ti ngoi so ahon, ni la ngoi alingbi ti pëpe ni pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Si atënë ayeke makoni wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Makoni ti atënë ayeke standard pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: Ye so a sïngö gbä na yâ ti texte ayeke contenu, na ye so mo wara na lege ti akpale ayeke hakinda (inférence).
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: ① a sïngö ni biani na yâ ti texte, na ② a sïngö ni pëpe, ni la standard ayeke si a sïngö ni gbä wala pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ngoi na kötä ayeke mbeni, ni la mo lingbi ti pëpe ni na si a sïngö ni gbä na yâ ti texte wala pëpe.

l-e-m3-b02-06.s.s1.r.d: Sujet ayeke critère tî partager sortes ape.
l-e-m3-b02-06.s.s1.explain: Tî fait so asi ngbii kûê, sara kua na présent + présent. Tî ye tî futur particulier, sara kua na présent + will.
l-e-m3-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: ① ayeke vrai ngbii kûê na ② atene na ndö tî ôko lâ, tongana, ndali ni critère ayeke so ni ayeke fait wala ôko ye tî futur.
l-e-m3-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Phrases use kûê ayeke na if na kozo, ndali ni mo lingbi tî partager ala na ni ape, na mo bezoin so ni ayeke fait général wala ye tî futur particulier.

l-e-m3-b02-09.goal: Tî gi standard tî partager pronoms relatifs who na whose, sï critère (information) so a bezoin tâ, na fa ndali wa mo sï ni.
l-e-m3-b02-09.material: I met a person ___ is kind. I met a person ___ dog is huge. Who wala whose? Gi critère tî décider ôko wa tî sara kua na ni.

l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.o.b: So nom so aga kozo ayeke zo
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.b: Phrases use kûê atene na ndö tî zo, me ala apartager na who na whose.
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.o.c: So clause principale ayeke na passé
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.c: Temps apartager who na whose ape.
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.d: Longueur apartager who na whose ape.
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s1.explain: Tongana nom so afa '~ tî zo so' aga na pekoni, sara kua na whose. Tongana verbe aga tâ na pekoni, sara kua na who.
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.0: Na phrases use kûê, ye so aga kozo ayeke zo, ndali ni so ni ayeke zo wala pëpe ayeke critère ape; critère ayeke so possession tongana dog aga na pekoni wala pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.1: Is kind ayeke na zo tongana sujet, na dog is huge atene na ndö tî chien tî zo, ndali ni mo bezoin tâ relation tî possession.

l-e-m3-b07-05.title: Critère ti hînga "whose" na "who's"
l-e-m3-b07-05.goal: Ti hînga "whose" wala "who's" ayeke na ndo ti gue, sara choix ti critère (information) so a lingbi ti hînga biani, na fa raison ti choix ti mo.
l-e-m3-b07-05.material: Sara choix ti "whose" wala "who's" na ndo ti gue. ① I met a student ___ bike is blue. ② I met a student ___ riding a blue bike.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Critère so a lingbi ti hînga biani ti sara choix na popo ti "whose" na "who's" ayeke nye?
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.a: Tongana a kâ ndo ti gue na "who is", a yeke nzoni wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.b: Mot so ayeke na kozo ayeke zo wala pëpe
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Use alingbi ti sara na ni na peko ti zo, ni la a lingbi ti sara popo ti ala pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Fini ti mots ayeke na lien na lege ti sarango pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.d: Couleur afa lege na "whose" na "who's" ape.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.explain: "who's" ayeke forme kete ti "who is." ② a lire ni tongana "who is riding," ni la ni ayeke "who's," na ① alingbi ti ayeke "who is bike" ape, ni la ni ayeke "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: "who's" ayeke forme kete ti "who is," ni la tongana ni asara sens tongana a kpe ni na "who is," sara kua na "who's," na tongana ape, sara kua na "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Tongana mo zia "who is" na yâ, ② aga naturel na ① aga étrange, ni la critère so gï alingbi ti fa lege na aphrases use.

l-e-m3-b01-11.title: Règle ti ngoi ti averbe use na yâ ti phrase ti if
l-e-m3-b01-11.goal: Wara na fa règle ni na akpale mingi na yâ ti phrases ota ti if, na bâ règle ni na mbeni cas ti vuko.
l-e-m3-b01-11.material: ① If water reaches 0°C, it freezes. ② If you mix red and blue, you get purple. ③ If you press the button, the light turns on. Wara règle ni na phrases ota ni.
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Règle so mo lingbi ti wara na phrases ota ni ayeke nyen?
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Proposition ti if ayeke na ngoi ti présent, na proposition principale asara kua na will
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: Will ayeke na yâ ti phrases ota ni pëpe. Ni alingbi na akpale ni pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.o.b: Propositions use ni kue ayeke na ngoi ti présent, na atene fait so asi na ngoi kue
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.o.c: Proposition ti if ayeke na ngoi so ahon ti tene tënë ti bê
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: Mbeni ti phrases ota ni ayeke na ngoi so ahon pëpe.
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.o.d: Tongana if ayeke dä, proposition principale ayeke ordre na ngoi kue
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana proposition ti if na proposition principale ayeke na ngoi ti présent, atene fait wala règle so ayeke tongana ni na ngoi kue.
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: Na yâ ti phrases ota ni kue propositions use ni ayeke na ngoi ti présent na afa ye so asi na ngoi kue, ni la présent + présent afa fait so ayeke ngbanga na ngoi kue.
l-e-m3-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Will wala ngoi so ahon ayeke dä pëpe, na résultat ni mbeni asi mbeni, ni la règle ayeke so ngoi ti présent use afa mbeni fait.

l-e-m3-b01-12.title: Ndani ti participe passé na kozo ti nom
l-e-m3-b01-12.goal: Wara na fa règle ni na akpale mingi ti atënë so ayeke na participe passé na kozo ti nom, na bâ règle ni na mbeni cas ti vuko.
l-e-m3-b01-12.material: a closed door, a broken window, a fallen leaf, a frozen lake. Wara règle ni na ndani so mot so ayeke na kozo ti nom (closed, broken, na ape) afa na yâ ti atënë ota use ni.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.prompt: Règle so mo wara ayeke nyen?
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.a: Mot ti kozo afa ndani ti "ayeke sara", so ayeke progrès
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.a: A yeke na yâ ti ngoi ti kpe pëpe; a yeke na état ti kpe awe.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.b: Mot ti kozo atene tënë ti ye so ayeke si na pekoni
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: Atënë ota ni kue ayeke résultat ti ye so asi awe.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.c: Mot ti kozo afa état ti "a sara ni awe" wala "a ga awe"
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.d: Mot ti kozo afa gï na pekoni ti nom
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: Na yâ ti atënë ota ni kue, mot ti kozo ayeke na kozo ti nom.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Participe passé na kozo ti nom afa état ti ye so asi awe wala so a ga tongana ni awe.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: Tongana kodoro so a kpa ni na fenêtre so a kângbi ni, ala yeke état so asi na ye so asi awe, ni la participe passé afa état ti "asara awe".
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Tënë ti ye use kue so ala fa si ye ni asi tongana résultat ti ye so asara awe, ni la règle ni ayeke état ti "asara awe/ga".

l-e-m3-b01-13.title: Règle ti ndo ti mots ti how + adjectif
l-e-m3-b01-13.goal: Gi règle na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi na yâ ti hunda ota so ayeke na how, na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b01-13.material: ① I wonder how tall the tower is. ② Tell me how far the park is. ③ Do you know how old the building is? Gi règle so ayeke na peko ti how na yâ ti phrases ota.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.a: how na adjectif a sara na ni na ndo use
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.r.a: tall, far, na old ayeke tongana na yanga ti how.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.b: Adjectif ayeke na peko ti how, na sujet + verbe ayeke na peko ni
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.c: Verbe ayeke na kozo na peko ti how
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: Sujet ayeke na kozo, tongana na tower is na park is.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.d: A sara na how na terê ti phrase
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, how ayeke na popo ti phrase.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.explain: Tongana na how tall na how far, how na adjectif/adverbe ayeke na kozo tongana oko, na sujet + verbe ayeke na peko ni.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: how tall, how far, na how old ayeke ngbâ oko, na sujet na verbe ayeke na peko ni, ni la règle ayeke how + adjectif + sujet + verbe.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Adjectif asara popo na how pëpe na verbe ayeke na peko ti sujet, ni la so ayeke règle ni.

l-e-m3-b01-14.title: Règle ti clauses so when na why ayeke na kozo ni
l-e-m3-b01-14.goal: Gi règle na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi na yâ ti phrases ota so ayeke na when na why, na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b01-14.material: I remember the day when we met. This is the reason why I left. Summer is the season when it rains a lot. Gi règle ti when na why na yâ ti phrases ota.

l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.a: day, reason, na season ayeke ndo pëpe.

l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.o.c: Gi verbe so ayeke na peko ti when na why
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: Sujet tongana we, I, wala it ayeke na peko ti when/why.
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.o.d: A sara na when na why na terê ti phrase
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, when/why ayeke na popo ti phrase.
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Sara na when na peko ti nom ti temps na why na peko ti nom ti raison, na sujet + verbe ayeke na peko ni.
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: day na season ayeke temps na reason ayeke raison, na sujet na verbe ayeke na peko ti when/why, ni la règle ayeke ti sara na ala na peko ti nom ti temps wala ti raison.
l-e-m3-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, clause ti when/why afa nom ti temps wala ti raison, ni la so ayeke règle ni.

l-e-m3-b01-15.title: Kua ti phrase ti kozo ti paragraphe
l-e-m3-b01-15.goal: Gi règle na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi na yâ ti paragraphes ti anglais ota, na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b01-15.material: ① Dogs need exercise. They walk daily and play games. ② Sleep helps students. Tired students forget more. ③ Recycling saves energy. Making a can from scrap uses less power. Gi règle na yâ ti paragraphes ota.
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: Phrase ti terê ni afa tënë ti yâ
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.a: Phrase ti terê ni ayeke détail.

l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: Phrase so ayeke kota ahon ayeke tënë ti yâ
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Phrase so ayeke kota ahon ayeke détail.
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: Paragraphe oko oko ayeke na tënë ti yâ use
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Paragraphe oko oko afa tënë oko.
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Phrase ti kozo ti paragraphe oko oko ayeke tënë ti yâ, na phrases so ayeke na peko ni ayeke détails so amû ngangu na tënë ni.
l-e-m3-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Na yâ ti paragraphes ota kue, phrase ti kozo afa sujet na phrases so ayeke na peko ni amû raisons wala exemples, ni la phrase ti kozo ayeke tënë ti yâ.

l-e-m3-b02-11.title: Règle tî If + passé, would
l-e-m3-b02-11.goal: Na yâ tî cas mingi tî phrases ota tî if so atene na ndö tî imagination, gi na tene règle, na vérifier règle so na cas nouveau.
l-e-m3-b02-11.material: ① If I had a boat, I would sail every day. ② If we lived near the sea, we would swim often. ③ If I were taller, I would play basketball. Gi règle na yâ tî phrases ota.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: Clause tî if asara kua na présent, na clause principale asara kua na will
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Phrases ota ayeke na would, will ape.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Clause tî if na passé plus would na clause principale atene na ndö tî imagination
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Clause tî if a sû ni na plus-que-parfait
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Had a boat ayeke passé simple. Ni ayeke plus-que-parfait ape.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Tongana if ayeke, clause principale ayeke ngbii kûê na présent
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Clause principale ayeke na would, ndali ni ayeke présent ape.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: If + passé, would + verbe tî base atene na ndö tî imagination so ayeke nde na faits tî lâ so. Verbe be a sara kua na ni na were na habitude.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Na phrases ota kûê, clause tî if ayeke na passé na clause principale ayeke na would, ndali ni ala atene na ndö tî imagination na ndö tî lâ so.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Verbe na passé na would aga na ôko na ni ayeke tâ ape, ndali ni règle ayeke imagination na passé + would.

l-e-m3-b02-12.material: the kid sitting near me / the people waiting outside / the window broken by a ball / the cake baked by my uncle. Gi règle ti sarango na -ing na -ed na yâ ti tënë ti ye use kue.

l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: -ing na -ed afa zo so asara kua wala so awara kua, a fa temps pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: A sara na -ed gi na kozo ti nom
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: Na yâ ti tënë use kue, -ed aga na peko ti nom.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: A lingbi ti sara na participe na peko ti nom pëpe
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Na yâ ti tënë use kue, participe ayeke na peko ti nom.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Tongana nom asara kua, a zia -ing na peko ni. Tongana a sara kua na ni, a zia -ed na peko ti nom.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Kid so ayeke sitting na people so ayeke waiting asara ni terê ti ala, ni la -ing; window so a kpa ni na cake so a bake ni awara kua ni, ni la -ed.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: A kpa window na ballon na a bake cake, ni la règle ayeke so -ed ayeke ti kua so a sara na ni na -ing ayeke ti sarango.

l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.prompt: Règle so mo wara ayeke nyen?
l-e-m3-b02-13.title: Règle ti hunda yes/no so ayeke na yâ ti phrase
l-e-m3-b02-13.goal: Na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi ti phrases ota so ayeke na hunda yes/no, gi règle na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b02-13.material: ① I don't know if the store is open. ② Can you tell me whether the bus is late? ③ I wonder if it will rain. Gi règle na yâ ti phrases ota.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.a: A yeke ga na that ngbii kue
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.a: Phrases ota ayeke na that pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: A yeke ga na if wala whether, na lege ti sujet + verbe
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.c: A sara na if na terê ti phrase
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.c: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, if ayeke na popo ti phrase.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.d: A yeke ga na mot ti hunda where
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.d: Phrases ota ayeke na where pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Hunda yes/no aga na if wala whether, na ye so ayeke na peko ni ayeke na lege ti sujet + verbe.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, sujet na verbe ayeke na peko ti if wala whether, ni la hunda yes/no ayeke if/whether + sujet + verbe.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Teti so mot ti hunda ayeke pëpe, règle ayeke ti sara na if wala whether na ndo ti where wala that.

l-e-m3-b02-14.goal: Na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi ti phrases ota so where aga na ni, gi règle na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b02-14.material: This is the town where I was born. That is the room where we eat. The shop where I work is small. Gi règle ti where na yâ ti phrases ota.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: A sara na where na peko ti zo
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Town, room, na shop kue ayeke ando.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Gi verbe so ayeke na peko ti where
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.b: Sujet tongana I wala we aga na peko ti where.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: A sara na ni na peko ti ndo na sujet + verbe ayeke na peko ni
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.d: A sara na where na peko ti nom ti temps
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Town, room, na shop ayeke ando, a yeke temps pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Na peko ti nom so afa ndo, where ayeke ga na clause so afa 'ndo so ye asi na yâ ni'.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: Town, room, na shop kue ayeke ando, na sujet na verbe tongana I wala we na verbe ayeke na peko ti where, ni la règle ayeke ndo + where + sujet + verbe.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, clause ti where afa nom ti ndo, ni la règle ayeke so a sara na where na peko ti ndo.

l-e-m3-b02-15.title: Lien so amots ti kpe-ndo afa
l-e-m3-b02-15.goal: Na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi ti phrases ota so ayeke na amots ti kpe-ndo, gi règle na bâ règle ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b02-15.material: ① The room was small, but it was warm. ② I like apples. However, my cousin prefers pears. ③ The road was long. Still, we walked. Gi ye so but, However, na Still ayeke na ni oko na yâ ti phrases ota.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.prompt: Kua so ala kue ayeke na ni oko ayeke nye?
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: A mû raison ti ye so aga na kozo
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.a: Ni asara choix ti fruit so ayeke mbeni, ni la a yeke contraste, raison pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: A fa mbeni lege so ayeke mbeni na so aga na kozo (contraste)
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.c: A tene mbeni lege ye so aga na kozo biani
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Na yâ ti phrases ota kue, mbeni ye so ayeke mbeni na so aga na kozo ayeke na peko ni.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: A fa lege so ye asi na ni
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: Ala fa contraste, lege ti ye pëpe.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.explain: But, However, na Still ayeke signal so afa so mbeni ye so ayeke contre ti so aga na kozo ayeke na peko ni.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: Room ayeke kete me chaud na lege ayeke kota me ala gue, ni la amots ota ayeke signal ti contraste so asara lien na ye so ayeke mbeni na so aga na kozo.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ye so ayeke na peko ni ayeke contre ti so aga na kozo, ni la kua so ala kue ayeke na ni oko ayeke contraste.

l-e-m3-b03-11.title: Règle ti phrases ota ti unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.goal: Bâ akpale mingi ti phrases ota so ayeke na unless, sioni règle ni, na bâ ni na mbeni cas ti vuko.
l-e-m3-b03-11.material: ① Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus. ② Unless it rains, we will play outside. ③ Unless you study, you won't pass. Wara règle ti unless na yâ ti phrases ota ni.

l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: Na yâ ti ①, mo bi bus pëpe tongana mo kpe; mo bi ni tongana mo kpe pëpe.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.b: Proposition principale ayeke vrai tongana ye ti unless asi pëpe
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.c: Passé aga na pekoni tî unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Phrases ota kûê asara kua na présent.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.d: Unless a sara kua na ni gï na pekoni tî clause principale
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: Na phrases ota kûê, unless ayeke na kozo tî phrase.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Unless ayeke même na if ~ not. Clause principale ayeke vrai tongana ye so aga na pekoni tî unless asi ape.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: Na phrases ota kûê, résultat aga tongana mo pressé ape, pluie aga ape, wala mo étudier ape, ndali ni unless ayeke if ~ not.

l-e-m3-b03-12.title: Règle tî ndo so participe aga
l-e-m3-b03-12.goal: Bâ exemples mingi tî expressions 6 na participes, tene règle, na vérifier ni na cas nouveau.
l-e-m3-b03-12.material: The sleeping baby / the baby sleeping in the car; a broken toy / a toy broken by the kids; the running water / the water running from the tap. Gi règle tî position tî participes.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Participe aga ngbii kûê kozo tî nom
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Ni aga nga na pekoni tî nom, tongana the baby sleeping in the car.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Participe ôko aga kozo, na tongana anzo akângbi, ni aga na pekoni
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Ni aga nga kozo tî nom, tongana the sleeping baby.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: -ing aga kozo na -ed aga gï na pekoni
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: -ed aga nga kozo (a broken toy) na na pekoni (a toy broken by).
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Participe so ayeke ôko gï adécrire nom na kozo, na tongana anzo aga na pekoni, tongana by the kids, ni adécrire na pekoni tî nom.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Participe ôko, tongana sleeping baby, ague kozo, na na in the car akângbi ni ague na pekoni, ndali ni règle ayeke so anzo akângbi wala pëpe.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Na paires ota kûê, participe so ayeke ôko gï ague kozo na na explication ajouté ague na pekoni, ndali ni so ayeke règle.

l-e-m3-b03-13.material: ① The guide asked where we were from. ② I asked if the train was late. ③ The clerk asked what I needed. Gi règle na yâ tî phrases ota.

l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: Na phrases ota kûê, verbes ayeke na passé, tongana were, was, na needed.

l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.b: Do/did ayeke ape na yâ tî phrases ota.

l-e-m3-b03-14.title: Règle tî prépositions na pronoms relatifs
l-e-m3-b03-14.goal: Bâ exemples mingi tî clauses relatives 4 na prépositions, tene règle, na vérifier ni na cas nouveau.
l-e-m3-b03-14.material: The friend I talked to / the friend to whom I talked / the chair I sat on / the chair on which I sat. Gi règle tî position tî préposition na yâ tî expressions 4.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.a: Préposition ague ngbii kûê na lï tî phrase
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.a: Ndambo expressions azia ni kozo, tongana to whom na on which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.b: Préposition ague ngbii kûê kozo tî pronom relatif
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.b: Ndambo expressions azia ni na lï, tongana talked to na sat on.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.c: Na lï, mot relatif alingbi tî a zî ni; na kozo, a bezoin ni
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.d: Mo bezoin tî sara kua na préposition ape
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: Expressions 4 kûê ayeke na to wala on.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Tongana mo zia préposition na lï, mo lingbi tî zî pronom relatif, na tongana mo zia ni kozo, mo lingbi tî sara kua na whom wala which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Friend I talked to azî ni na to whom asara kua na whom, ndali ni tongana préposition ayeke kozo, whom/which a bezoin ni.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Na préposition na lï, mot relatif alingbi tî ayeke ape, me kozo ni alingbi tî ayeke, ndali ni position ayeke règle.

l-e-m3-b04-11.title: Gi règle na exemples tî conditionnel na if
l-e-m3-b04-11.goal: Gi na tene règle na yâ tî exemples mingi tî phrases conditionnelles so acommencer na if, na pekoni vérifier règle na cas nouveau.
l-e-m3-b04-11.material: If it rains, we will stay home. / If he calls, I will answer. / If you run, you will win. Gi règle tî phrases ota so.

l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Clause tî if ayeke na kozo mingi tî phrase.

l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Will ayeke na yâ tî clause tî if ape; ni ayeke na rains, calls, na run.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana a tene na ndö tî ye so alingbi tî asi, clause tî if ayeke na présent na clause principale ayeke will + verbe tî base.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Na phrases ota kûê, clause tî if ayeke na présent tongana rains, calls, na run, na clause principale ayeke na will na verbe tî base aga na pekoni, ndali ni so ayeke règle.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Na If it rains, we will stay, clause tî if ayeke na présent na will ayeke na clause principale, ndali ni même règle alingbi nga na phrases nde.

l-e-m3-b06-11.material: If you finish early, you can go home. / If it is sunny, we may swim. / If you hurry, you should catch the bus. Wara règle ti aphrases ota.

l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.r.b: Will ayeke dä ape na yâ ti aclauses principales ti acas.

l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.r.c: Can, may, na should ayeke na clause principale, clause ti if ape.
l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.r.d: Mbeni verbe modal ti présent a sara kua na ni na clause principale, tongana can go.
l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.explain: Tongana clause ti if ayeke na présent, averbes modaux tongana can, may, na should alingbi nga ti aga na clause principale, will gï ape.

l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s2.model.1: Mo sa choix verbe modal ti kpe na sens ti permission, possibilité, wala conseil, ni la règle aga so clause principale asara kua gï na will ape.

l-e-m3-b07-02.title: Règle ti hunda ndirect so mot ti hunda + nom ayeke kâ na ni
l-e-m3-b07-02.goal: Na popo ti akasa ti ye mingi ti hunda ndirect so mot ti hunda na nom ayeke oko, tongana "what size," gi règle na bâ ni na mbeni kasa ti fini.
l-e-m3-b07-02.material: What color do you like? → Tell me what color you like. / Which road does the bus take? → Do you know which road the bus takes? / Whose bag is this? → I wonder whose bag this is. Gi règle.

l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: "do" ayeke ngbâ, ni la a yeke lege ti mots ti hunda direct. Na hunda ndirect, "do" ayeke ga pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Groupe ti mot ti hunda ayeke na kozo pëpe. A lingbi ti yeke na kozo.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Mot ti hunda + nom aga na kozo tongana groupe oko, na lege ti sujet + verbe ayeke na peko ni. "do/does" ayeke ga pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Tongana "what color," "which road," na "whose bag," mot ti hunda na nom aga na kozo tongana groupe oko na "do" ayeke ga pëpe, ni la "what size they need" ayeke nzoni.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Na yâ ti exemples ota kue, sujet na verbe ayeke na peko ti mot ti hunda + nom na "do/does" ayeke ga pëpe, ni la sara choix ti "what size they need."

l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Soro kozo mbôli so aga sio.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke résultat ti sioni ti ③. Ni ayeke ndo ti kozo so ni asi na sioni pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-03.title: Tënë so tongana bibliothèque akângbi, mbi ye ti hînga ti mbi pëpe
l-e-m3-b07-03.goal: Bâ na lege na lege tënë ti conditionnel na lâ so bibliothèque akângbi, wala lien ti raison na résultat, gi ndo kozo so a sara sioni na ni na tö ni.
l-e-m3-b07-03.material: Règle: If the library is open, I will study there. Tënë ti lâ so: ① Règle atene mbi hînga tongana a yeke ouvert. ② Lâ so bibliothèque akângbi. ③ A yeke clause ti if pëpe, ni la clause ti yâ asi pëpe nga. ④ Ni la mbi hînga lâ so pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.o.a: ① Règle so tongana a yeke ouvert, mbi hînga
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Lege so a tene règle gi agbian, ni la a yeke sio pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: A yeke tâ tënë so a mû, ni la a yeke ndo ti sioni pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.o.c: ③ A yeke clause ti if pëpe, ni la clause ti yâ asi pëpe nga
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ni la mbi hînga lâ so pëpe
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Règle atene gi tongana a yeke ouvert. Na lâ so akângbi, mbi lingbi ti hînga na mbeni ndo, ni la ③ ayeke na nda pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: Atâa clause ti if asi pëpe, mo lingbi ti tene so clause ti yâ asi pëpe, ayeke pëpe, ni la ③ ayeke sioni ti kozo. Mbi lingbi ti hînga na mbeni ndo.
l-e-m3-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: Règle atene gi tënë ti ouvert, ni la mo lingbi ti hînga ti lâ so akângbi pëpe. Tö ③ na "Mbi lingbi ti hînga na mbeni ndo."

l-e-m3-b01-28.material: When does the bus leave? Zia question so pekoni ti "Do you know ...?" ti sara phrase so ahunda ye même.

l-e-m3-b01-28.s.s1.r.b: when angbâ na kozo, na sujet + verbe aga pekoni.
l-e-m3-b01-28.s.s1.r.c: does angbâ, ni la ni ayeke ordre ti amots ti question directe même.

l-e-m3-b01-28.s.s2.model.1: Question indirecte a sara écrire sujet na verbe na ordre pekoni ti when, ni la Do you know when the bus leaves? ayeke question même.

l-e-m3-b07-04.title: Sara na phrase ti participe ti raison ti négatif
l-e-m3-b07-04.goal: Sû "Because we didn't know the way" na phrase ti participe na mbeni forme ti fini (équation, tableau, image, wala mots) na fa raison so a yeke fini oko.
l-e-m3-b07-04.material: Because we didn't know the way, we asked for help. Tö phrase so na phrase ti participe so akâ na -ing ti sara phrase so ayeke na fini oko.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.prompt: Sara choix ti phrase so a tö ni ti yeke na fini oko.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.a: Ti négatif, zia "Not," "No" pëpe, na kozo ti -ing.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: "not" ayeke pëpe, ni la a lingbi ti fa so ala hînga lege.

l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Phrase ti participe négatif azia "Not" na kozo ti -ing. Sujet "we" ti clause ti kozo ayeke oko na ti use, ni la a zia ni pëpe.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: "Because we didn't know" a sara ni kete na "Not knowing," ni la "Not knowing the way, we asked for help" ayeke na fini oko.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: Sujet "we" ayeke oko na akasa use, ni la a zia sujet ti clause ti kozo pëpe na "Not" aga na kozo ti -ing, so asara phrase so ayeke na fini oko na ti kozo.

l-e-m3-b03-31.s.s1.r.b: Clause ti if alingbi nga ti aga pekoni ti clause principale.
l-e-m3-b03-31.s.s1.o.c: B: Virgule a ye ni na ngoi kue même tongana clause ti if aga pekoni

l-e-m3-b03-31.s.s2.model.0: Clause ti if ayeke pekoni ti clause principale, ni la A, so a sara écrire ni sans virgule, alingbi.
l-e-m3-b03-31.s.s2.model.1: A sara kua na virgule tongana clause ti if aga kozo, ni la a ye ni ape tongana ni aga pekoni.

l-e-m3-b03-32.material: Aétudiants use atene tënë ti burning house na burned house. A: -ing afa angbâ maintenant, na -ed afa asuka déjà. B: -ing na -ed afa ye même. Kaï oko nyen alingbi.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.o.a: B: Aexpressions use afa ye même
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.r.a: Burning afa angbâ ti brûler, na burned afa abrûler déjà.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.o.b: A: -ing ayeke ye so asuka déjà
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.r.b: -ing ayeke angbâ, na -ed ayeke état so asuka.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.o.c: A: Burning afa angbâ ti brûler, na burned afa na état ti brûler
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.o.d: B: -ed a sara kua na ni kozo ti -ing
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.r.d: Ayeke ordre ti usage ape; asens ayeke sio.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s1.explain: Burning ayeke ndo so ayeke brûler maintenant, na burned ayeke ndo so abrûler déjà.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s2.model.0: Burning afa angbâ ti brûler na burned afa pekoni ti ni abrûler, ni la A alingbi.
l-e-m3-b03-32.s.s2.model.1: Tongana aexpressions use afa ye même, mo lingbi ti fa lege na asituations ape, ni la A, so asa tri ye so angbâ na ye so asuka, ayeke tâ.
